can_be_cancelled.description: can_be_cancelled indicates if the schedule can be cancelled

cancelled_at.description: cancelled_at is when the schedule was cancelled

configuration.description: configuration contains type-specific configuration (e.g., target_plan_id for plan changes)

days_until_execution.description: days_until_execution is the number of days until execution

error_message.description: error_message contains the error if execution failed

executed_at.description: executed_at is when the schedule was executed

scheduled_at.description: scheduled_at is when the schedule will execute

subscription_id.description: subscription_id is the ID of the subscription
